title: Argentina.gob.ar — El tenis argentino prepara sus bases en el CeNARD
scope: Official Argentine government report on the AAT’s 2026 DETA national U10/U12 talent camp at CeNARD and its interdisciplinary technical, physical, nutrition and biomechanics support.
limitations: One national talent camp demonstrates current pathway/support capacity for a selected cohort; it is not nationwide participation or realised elite performance.
